rules.citation: S.F. Rent Board, Security Deposit Interest Rate (March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027)
citation_aliases: SF.gov Current Rates, including Rent Increase, Relocation, Sec. Deposit

coverage.summary: The passage gives only the annual security deposit interest rate; it does not state which units are covered.

rules.effective_date_note: The rate applies to the period March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027. The Rent Board publishes a new rate each year.
rules.key_value: Security deposit interest rate 4.2% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027 (prior years: 5.0% for 2025-26; 5.2% for 2024-25)
rules.requirement: San Francisco landlords holding security deposits must pay tenants interest at the annual rate set by the Rent Board. For March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027 that rate is 4.2%.
rules.review_note: The passage does not name the underlying ordinance, so the citation is descriptive. Deposit caps, return deadlines and deductions for San Francisco are not stated in the passages.
rules.source_notes: Official SF.gov Rent Board rates page.
rules.title: San Francisco Rent Board annual security deposit interest rate
